test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 09 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
The following table shows the marks obtained by six students in four subjects in an examination in the year 2016. (The maximum marks for each subject are 100.)

 

 
 

 Student/Subject
 En
solution:
**Given:**

Marks obtained by students:

English: 84, 86, 75, 88, 77, 72

Hindi: 80, 85, 79, 83, 74, 88

Mathematics: 100, 92, 100, 99, 95, 100

Science: 100, 90, 99, 93, 75, 72

**Formula used:**

Average Marks = (Total Marks in Subject) / (Number of Students)

**Calculation:**

Average in English = (84 + 86 + 75 + 88 + 77 + 72) / 6

⇒ Average in English = 482 / 6 = 80.33

Average in Hindi = (80 + 85 + 79 + 83 + 74 + 88) / 6

⇒ Average in Hindi = 489 / 6 = 81.50

Average in Mathematics = (100 + 92 + 100 + 99 + 95 + 100) / 6

⇒ Average in Mathematics = 586 / 6 = 97.67

Average in Science = (100 + 90 + 99 + 93 + 75 + 72) / 6

⇒ Average in Science = 529 / 6 = 88.17

**∴ The best performance was in Mathematics.**
